provenance.dtraining_commit_note: Deployed matrix code era (main @ 11cdb16 'Record transmitted obf_epoch in wire sidecars even when the cloud holds no seed'). Toula's ~/dtraining checkout is an ancestor-descendant match of local main; at collection time it sits at 63179b9, which contains 11cdb16.

scope_note: Only JSON artifacts were collected: summary.json, identity*.json, and session_*/wire_attack_*.json. .pt wire-capture files and w_session_*.key key material were deliberately excluded (gitignored / too large / sensitive). Sessions 2 and 3 of every run contain only the ratchet and static wire_attack JSONs; the base arm is measured once in session_1 by harness design. This matches the previously archived cell er_n16_rtt0_20260810T213415 under collected/invalid/toula/er/.
known_limitations: In shared-key mode the cloud derives W_t itself, so per-epoch freshness protects the wire and logged captures, not cloud RAM.

Two sessions (er_n16_* sess2, er_budget_* sess1) show C_identity=false caused by exactly one flipped token at the same position in both rtt twins (0 ms and 80 ms). Diagnosed as deterministic bf16 borderline-logit rounding across the W round-trip, NOT a ratchet race: the flip is bit-identical across the rtt=0/rtt=80 twin, which a timing race would not reproduce. Affected cells are valid with this known limitation.
